__comment: The player head as a block pack wants it: the same head as mobheads:item/player, plus the skin's own hat layer. Kept apart from the item model because the icon renderer samples a hair outside a face's rect at a silhouette edge, and the extra box — transparent on a default skin — still fringes the icon with a few pixels of whatever sits next to the hat unwrap. A block pack is drawn by a GPU from the geometry rather than by that rasterizer, so it takes the hat and the icon does not.
